column4: julia --project=. -e 'for f in filter(x->endswith(x,".jl"), readdir("src")); Meta.parse(read("src/$f", String)); end'

column3: cd test && swipl -q --on-error=status -g "use_module(library(plunit)), expand_file_name('*_test.pl', A), expand_file_name('*_tests.pl', B), append(A, B, Fs), (Fs = [] -> (expand_file_name('*.pl', Other), (Other = [] -> (consult('../src/{module}.pl'), writeln('Scaffold: no tests configured')); (format(user_error, 'No recognized Prolog test files~n', []), fail))); (maplist(consult, Fs), run_tests(all, [summary(S)]), get_dict(passed, S, P), get_dict(failed, S, F), get_dict(timeout, S, T), get_dict(blocked, S, BCount), format('Prolog tests: ~d passed, ~d failed, ~d timed out, ~d blocked~n', [P, F, T, BCount]), (P > 0, F =:= 0, T =:= 0 -> true; (P =:= 0, F =:= 0, T =:= 0 -> (format(user_error, 'No Prolog test cases executed~n', []), fail); fail)))), halt" -t 'halt(1)'
